#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int totalNumbers, budget;
    std::cin >> totalNumbers >> budget;
    std::vector<int> sequence(totalNumbers);
    std::vector<int> costArray(totalNumbers, -1);

    for (int i = 0; i < totalNumbers; ++i) {
        std::cin >> sequence[i];
    }

    int evenCounter = 0, oddCounter = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < totalNumbers; ++i) {
        if (sequence[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++evenCounter;
        } else {
            ++oddCounter;
        }
        if (evenCounter == oddCounter && i != totalNumbers - 1) {
            costArray[i] = std::abs(sequence[i + 1] - sequence[i]);
            evenCounter = 0;
            oddCounter = 0;
        }
    }

    std::sort(costArray.begin(), costArray.end());

    int sumCost = 0, countCuts = 0;
    for (int c : costArray) {
        if (c != -1) {
            sumCost += c;
            if (sumCost > budget) break;
            ++countCuts;
        }
    }

    std::cout << countCuts << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
